description: Originality guardrail — compare a built page/source/description against a reference site and flag shared recognizable fingerprints. Use after build_from_reference_v2, before showing or publishing, to avoid producing a design that is visually too close to the inspiration.

candidate_description.description: Plain-language description of the built design if source is unavailable

candidate_source.description: Built page HTML/CSS/JSX to compare against the reference

favorite_bits.description: The same favorite bits passed to build_from_reference_v2, if any

reference_url.description: Public URL of the reference site the user liked

name: critique_similarity
